name: Injury deaths by county and state (CDC): drug overdose, suicide, homicide and firearm injury
description: Deaths from drug overdose, suicide, homicide and firearm injury in CDC's Mapping Injury, Overdose, and Violence files, for the nation, each state and DC and each county, by calendar year and for the trailing twelve months: deaths and the rate per 100,000 residents. National and state records add unintentional-injury deaths from the NCHS leading-causes file, 1999 to 2017. Counts of 1 to 9 stay in the range CDC prints.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Injury deaths by county and state (CDC): drug overdose, suicide, homicide and firearm injury (Version 1.0.1) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.24116039

distribution.name: injury-deaths.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: injury-deaths.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

recordSet.name: injury-deaths
recordSet.description: The records of Injury deaths by county and state (CDC): drug overdose, suicide, homicide and firearm injury, one per CSV row.

field.name: area
